subject: Embeddings pricing & dimensional tiers — rate card request
messages:
From: Sasha Liu <sasha.liu@datamesh.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Embeddings pricing and dimensional tiers — rate card request

Hi Hannah,

We're evaluating Redwood for our vector search pipeline and I wanted to get a single-sheet view of your embeddings pricing and any rules around dimensionality and model support. A few specifics up front:

- Estimated traffic: ~7M vectors/month (indexing) + 800k query vectors/month.
- Typical text payloads: short documents (~120 tokens) and some mid-length metadata (~400 tokens).
- We need support for 768 and 1536-d vectors (some models produce variable sizes).

Would you send:
1) Baseline hosted embedding rates (per-vector or per-1k vectors) across common dimension buckets,
2) Whether input token volume is billed separately and how that factors into cost,
3) Which embedding models you currently expose (and any differences in pricing),
4) Any published discounts/commitments for volume or multi-month prepay, and
5) A rate card PDF if available.

I've attached our rough volume forecast to help you recommend tiers. Happy to jump on a quick 20m call if easier.

Thanks,
Sasha Liu
Head of Platform
DataMesh Labs
attachments: DataMesh-volume-forecast.xlsx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Liu <sasha.liu@datamesh.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing and dimensional tiers — rate card request

Hi Sasha — thanks for the detailed note and the forecast. I've summarized the baseline hosted pricing and a few recommendations below; attaching our one‑page rate card for completeness.

Baseline hosted embeddings (public list, per 1k vectors):
- Dim <= 512: $0.35 per 1k vectors
- 513 <= Dim <= 1024: $0.60 per 1k vectors
- 1025 <= Dim <= 2048: $1.00 per 1k vectors
- Dim > 2048: custom pricing (please share sample sizes)

Token billing: input tokens for text->embedding conversions are included in the per-vector price for short inputs (<= 1k tokens). For very large inputs we bill additional input token processing at $0.002 per 1k input tokens.

Model support (hosted):
- text-embed-3-small (512d) — listed rate above (Dim <= 512)
- text-embed-3-medium (768d) — falls into 513-1024 bucket
- text-embed-3-large (1536d) — falls into 1025-2048 bucket

Examples: if you index 7M vectors at 1536d using text-embed-3-large: cost = (7,000 * $1.00) = $7,000 (per 1k vectors) i.e. $7,000/month before discounts. Queries billed the same per vector.

Discount/commit path:
- 5% off for 3-month prepay of $10k+ monthly commitment
- 12% off for 12‑month committed spend >= $60k/month
- Custom enterprise pricing (15‑25% off) for >$250k monthly commitments or if Dedicated/Private deployment is required

Next steps I recommend:
1) Tell us the split of index vs query vectors (you labelled both, but the economics change if queries are much higher).
2) Confirm preferred model (medium vs large) — we can show a cost delta table.
3) If you'd like, we can put together a short mutual action plan and an illustrative discount for a 12mo commitment.

Attaching: Redwood-Embedding-Ratecard-v1.2.pdf

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing and dimensional tiers — rate card request

Hi Sasha — looping in a quick note on pricing flexibility and operational options. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- If DataMesh expects bursty ingestion (spikes due to bulk reindexing), we recommend mixing hosted with short-term Dedicated bursts — that can reduce unit cost on high-throughput windows.
- For discounts: we typically ladder discounts by committed ARR, but we can also offer a blended rate by splitting indexing and queries onto different SKUs (indexing-heavy workloads often get deeper discounts).
- Compliance: SOC2 and data residency options are available for Private deployments if you need isolated control — that affects pricing and contract terms.

If you can share the month-by-month ingest forecast (the sheet helps), I can run a quick model and propose a 12-month blended price and an example contract amendment for RDW-8731.

We can also expedite a short POC with 1M vectors free (trial quota) so you can validate latency and costs in your pipeline.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Liu <sasha.liu@datamesh.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings pricing and dimensional tiers — rate card request

Sasha — quick follow up with clarifications after Aditya's note.

- Model compatibility: the three hosted models we expose map to the buckets I listed. You can request a custom quantized variant for very high dimensional models, but that typically requires a Dedicated or Private setup.
- Dimensionality impact: larger dims increase both compute and storage; the listed slab pricing captures this. If you plan to downsample or project 1536->768 we can run a small eval to quantify retrieval quality vs cost.
- Tokens: short text inputs are covered; long documents (>
1000 tokens) should be chunked client-side where possible to avoid token surcharges.

I've attached the rate card again and a one-page mutual action plan template — if you confirm the split (index/query) and preferred model, Aditya and I will put together a 12‑month illustrative quote and a DocuSign link for an NDA/MA if you'd like to proceed.

Thanks — looking forward to the forecast.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
